channel.title: Ocean News & Technology Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: NYK Invests in Ocean-Tech Startup Oceanic Constellations
item.description: On February 5, NYK made an equity investment in Oceanic Constellations Inc. (OC) through a third-party allotment of new shares. The funds from this investment are expected to support OC’s efforts to establish a mass-production framework for unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), among other initiatives.

item.title: Australian Maritime College and HII Report Near-Perfect Availability as REMUS 100 Completes 935 Missions with Only Two Days of Downtime
item.description: The Australian Maritime College (AMC) and HII announced a major reliability milestone for AMC’s Legacy REMUS 100 autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV).

item.title: Orbital Marine Power Expands Global Contract Pipeline in Latest UK Allocation Round
item.description: Orbital Marine Power Ltd (Orbital), the Scotland-based floating tidal stream technology pioneer, and operator of the world’s most powerful tidal turbine, has been awarded a further Contract for Difference (CfD) in the UK Allocation Round 7 (AR7) process, resulting in our UK CfD project portfolio increasing to 17MW.

item.title: Lockheed Martin Unveils LampreyMMAUV
item.description: Lockheed Martin has unveiled the Lamprey Multi‑Mission Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (MMAUV), a breakthrough “plug-and‑play” submersible that gives US and allied warfighters technological and strategic advantage in today’s contested maritime arena.

item.title: New Marine Renewable Energy Sector Vision 2050 Sets a Clear Path for a Clean Energy Future
item.description: Marine Renewables Canada (MRC) released the Marine Renewable Energy Sector Vision 2050, a national roadmap outlining how offshore wind, tidal, wave, and river current energy can help meet Canada’s rapidly growing electricity demand while strengthening affordability, reliability, and energy security.

item.title: Transocean Ltd. Announces Contract Award and Extension
item.description: Transocean Ltd. (Transocean) announced contract fixtures for two of its harsh environment semisubmersibles in Norway. In aggregate, the fixtures represent approximately $184 million in firm contract backlog.

item.title: Davie Defense Awarded US Coast Guard Contract to Build Five Arctic Security Cutters
item.description: American shipbuilder, Davie Defense, has been awarded a contract from the United States Coast Guard (USCG) to build five Arctic Security Cutters (ASCs), a new class of polar icebreaker critical to increasing the US presence in the Arctic.

item.title: TGS Announces Engagement Phase 9 in the Gulf of America
item.description: TGS, a global provider of energy data and intelligence, in strategic collaboration with SLB, announced the launch of Engagement 9, the latest phase of the companies’ Ocean Bottom Node (OBN) multi-client campaign in the Gulf of America.

item.title: TGS Announces Multi-Client 2D Survey Offshore Angola
item.description: TGS, a global leader in energy data and intelligence, has announced the Ultra Profundo multi-client 2D survey offshore Angola. The survey covers approximately 12,600 line kilometers, and Ramform Victory commenced operations earlier in Q1. Data acquisition is estimated to be completed in approximately 100 days, with fast-track products available in Q3. Full data processing is scheduled for completion in Q2 2027.

item.title: CSA Ocean Sciences Joins APEM Group
item.description: APEM Group announced that CSA Ocean Sciences, a US-based environmental consultancy supporting energy transition and coastal infrastructure projects worldwide, has joined the Group.
